title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text:
FINDINGS:
Lung bases: 7 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe (series 3, image 12). No pleural effusion.
Liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenals and kidneys unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. No acute abdominal process.
2. Incidental 7 mm right lower lobe nodule; see Fleischner recommendation below.
RECOMMENDATION: CT chest in 6-12 months.
rationale: Fleischner 2017 single solid 6-8 mm, high risk: CT 6-12 mo.

title: CT chest without contrast
text:
IMPRESSION:
Solitary 11 mm solid nodule, left upper lobe, spiculated margin. Consider PET/CT or tissue sampling; alternatively CT in 3 months.
rationale: Fleischner >8 mm solid: CT 3 mo, PET/CT or tissue sampling.

title: CT chest
text:
FINDINGS: 5 mm calcified granuloma in the right middle lobe. No other nodules.
IMPRESSION: Benign calcified granuloma. No follow-up needed.

title: CT chest
text:
COMPARISON: CT chest 2024-08-30.
FINDINGS: 6 mm solid nodule in the left lower lobe is unchanged in size since 2024-08-30 (over 2 years).
IMPRESSION: Stable 6 mm LLL nodule for more than 2 years, consistent with a benign process. No further follow-up is required.
rationale: Solid nodule stable >=2 years: no further follow-up (Fleischner).

title: CT chest
text:
COMPARISON: 2026-03-10.
FINDINGS: The right upper lobe solid nodule now measures 10 mm, previously 6 mm.
IMPRESSION: Interval growth of right upper lobe nodule (6 -> 10 mm), suspicious for malignancy. Recommend PET/CT and pulmonology referral.

title: CT chest
text: IMPRESSION: 9 mm pure ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe. Recommend CT at 6-12 months to confirm persistence, then every 2 years until 5 years.

title: CT chest
text: IMPRESSION: Part-solid nodule in the left upper lobe, 14 mm total with an 8 mm solid component, persistent since CT 4 months ago. Highly suspicious. Recommend PET/CT and tissue sampling.
rationale: Persistent part-solid with solid component >=6 mm: work-up.

title: CT abdomen
text:
Lung bases: tiny 3 mm nodule in the right lower lobe.
IMPRESSION: No acute finding. 3 mm RLL nodule; in a low-risk patient no routine follow-up is recommended.
rationale: Solid <6 mm, low risk: no routine follow-up.

title: Chest CT (OCR from scanned outside report)
text: IMPRESSI0N: 8 rnm s0lid nodu1e in the RLL. F/U chest CT in 6-12 rnonths recornrnended.
rationale: OCR noise; solid 8 mm high risk: CT 6-12 mo.

title: CT chest
text:
IMPRESSION: Right lower lobe 8 mm opacity, likely nodule.

ADDENDUM (2026-09-15 14:20): On review of the prior chest radiograph and the soft-tissue window, the "nodule" represents the nipple shadow / skin tag. There is no pulmonary nodule. The recommendation for follow-up CT is withdrawn.
rationale: Addendum withdraws the finding and the recommendation.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS v2022 category 2 (benign appearance): 4 mm solid nodule RUL. Continue annual screening LDCT in 12 months.
rationale: Lung-RADS 2: annual screening, not a tracked rule.

title: LDCT screening
text:
FINDINGS: New 5 mm solid nodule in the left lower lobe.
IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 3 (probably benign). Recommend 6-month LDCT.

title: LDCT screening
text:
IMPRESSION:
Lung-RADS category: 4A.
Finding: 10 mm solid nodule, right upper lobe.
Management: 3-month LDCT; PET/CT may be considered.

title: LDCT screening
text: IMPRESSION: 18 mm solid nodule in the right upper lobe with spiculation. Lung-RADS 4X. Recommend diagnostic chest CT with contrast and/or PET/CT, and tissue sampling; referral to thoracic oncology.

title: 저선량 폐암검진 CT
text:
판독소견:
우상엽에 9 mm 크기의 고형 결절이 새로 관찰됨.

결론:
Lung-RADS 4A. 3개월 후 저선량 CT 추적검사 권함.

title: CT pulmonary angiography
text: IMPRESSION: Acute pulmonary emboli in the right lower lobe segmental and subsegmental arteries. No right heart strain. Findings discussed with Dr. Kim by telephone at 10:05.
rationale: Acute PE is a critical finding.

title: CT pulmonary angiography
text:
CLINICAL HISTORY: Prior pulmonary embolism 2024, on apixaban. Dyspnoea.
IMPRESSION: No pulmonary embolism. Mild bibasilar atelectasis.

title: CT head without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Chronic left convexity subdural hematoma, 6 mm, unchanged from 2026-08-01. No acute hemorrhage. No midline shift.
rationale: Stable chronic SDH, no acute hemorrhage: not a new critical result.

title: CT head without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Acute right parietal intraparenchymal hemorrhage, 2.5 x 2.0 cm, with surrounding edema. 3 mm leftward midline shift.

title: Chest radiograph portable
text:
Post right internal jugular central line placement.
IMPRESSION: New small right apical pneumothorax. Line tip at the cavoatrial junction.

title: Chest radiograph portable
text:
Right chest tube in place.
IMPRESSION: Small residual right apical pneumothorax, decreased from yesterday. Chest tube unchanged.
rationale: Known, decreasing pneumothorax with tube in place: not a new critical finding.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis
text:
Post laparoscopic cholecystectomy yesterday.
IMPRESSION: Small volume pneumoperitoneum, expected postoperative. No fluid collection. No contrast extravasation.
rationale: Expected postoperative free air without leak.

title: CT aorta angiography
text:
결론:
급성 대동맥 박리, Stanford A형. 상행대동맥에서 하행대동맥까지 내막 피판 관찰됨.
담당의에게 즉시 유선 보고함.

title: 흉부 CT 혈관조영술
text: 결론: 폐색전증 소견 없음. 우하엽 경미한 무기폐.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: Ruptured infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm, 7.1 cm, with large left retroperitoneal hematoma. Vascular surgery paged.

title: CT neck with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Incidental 1.8 cm hypodense nodule in the right thyroid lobe. Recommend thyroid ultrasound.
rationale: Incidental thyroid nodule >=1.5 cm on CT: US.

title: CT chest
text:
FINDINGS: 1.1 cm left thyroid nodule. Lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: No acute cardiopulmonary process. Small thyroid nodule, no further evaluation needed per ACR incidental thyroid guidance (age >=35, <1.5 cm, no suspicious features).
rationale: <1.5 cm at age >=35 without suspicious features: no US.

title: CT neck
text: IMPRESSION: 1.2 cm nodule in the left thyroid lobe. Recommend dedicated thyroid ultrasound.

title: PET/CT
text: IMPRESSION: Known right lung adenocarcinoma, FDG avid (SUVmax 11.2). Incidental focal FDG uptake in the left thyroid lobe (SUVmax 6.4) without CT correlate. Thyroid ultrasound recommended.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text:
Right lobe: 1.7 cm solid hypoechoic nodule, wider-than-tall, smooth margins, no echogenic foci. ACR TI-RADS 4 (TR4).
IMPRESSION: TR4 nodule 1.7 cm meets criteria for FNA.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text:
Left lobe: 0.8 cm spongiform nodule. ACR TI-RADS 1 (TR1).
IMPRESSION: Benign-appearing spongiform nodule. No FNA or follow-up needed.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text:
우엽에 1.3 cm 크기의 고형 저에코 결절, 미세석회화 동반, 경계 불규칙. K-TIRADS 5.
결론: 세침흡인검사(FNA) 권함.

title: CT abdomen with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.6 cm indeterminate left adrenal nodule (enhancing to 48 HU on portal venous phase only). Recommend adrenal protocol CT or chemical-shift MRI in 12 months.

title: CT abdomen without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.1 cm right adrenal nodule measuring -4 HU on unenhanced CT, consistent with a lipid-rich adenoma. No further imaging follow-up needed.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 4.6 cm heterogeneous right adrenal mass. Malignancy cannot be excluded. Recommend endocrine surgery referral and biochemical evaluation.

title: CT chest abdomen pelvis (staging)
text:
History: breast cancer.
IMPRESSION: New 1.4 cm left adrenal nodule, indeterminate, in this patient with breast cancer; metastasis not excluded. Recommend PET/CT or adrenal biopsy.
rationale: Adrenal >=1 cm with known cancer: work-up.

title: 복부 CT
text: 결론: 좌측 부신에 1.5 cm 결절, 비조영 CT에서 28 HU로 지방성 선종 기준 미달. 12개월 후 부신 프로토콜 CT 추적 권함.

title: CT abdomen with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 3.1 cm solid enhancing mass, interpolar left kidney (pre 32 HU, nephrographic 110 HU), suspicious for renal cell carcinoma. Urology referral recommended.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 2.4 cm Bosniak IIF cystic lesion in the right kidney with minimally thickened septa. Recommend CT or MRI follow-up at 6 months.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple simple renal cysts bilaterally, largest 4.2 cm (Bosniak I). No follow-up needed.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 1.9 cm right renal lesion containing macroscopic fat (-45 HU), consistent with angiomyolipoma. No further workup.

title: 복부 CT
text: 결론: 좌측 신장 하극에 2.8 cm 크기의 조영증강되는 고형 종괴, 신세포암 가능성 높음. 비뇨의학과 진료 권함.

title: MRI abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 1.2 cm unilocular cystic lesion in the pancreatic body without main duct dilatation or mural nodule, likely side-branch IPMN. Recommend MRI/MRCP in 2 years.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 2.8 cm cystic lesion in the pancreatic head with an enhancing 6 mm mural nodule and main pancreatic duct dilated to 8 mm. Worrisome features. Recommend EUS and pancreatic surgery consultation.

title: 복부 MRI
text: 결론: 췌장 미부에 1.8 cm 크기의 낭성 병변, 주췌관 확장이나 벽결절 없음. 1년 후 MRI/MRCP 추적 권함.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: Infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm, maximal diameter 4.2 cm, no periaortic stranding. Incidental simple left renal cyst.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: Infrarenal AAA measuring 5.2 cm. Recommend vascular surgery referral.
rationale: AAA >=5.0 cm in a woman: vascular surgery.

title: Ultrasound aorta
text: IMPRESSION: Ectatic infrarenal aorta measuring 2.7 cm. Surveillance ultrasound in 5 years.

title: Diagnostic mammogram and ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 1.4 cm irregular spiculated mass at 10 o'clock left breast. BI-RADS 5: highly suggestive of malignancy. Ultrasound-guided core biopsy recommended.

title: Screening mammogram
text: IMPRESSION: Scattered fibroglandular densities. Benign calcifications. BI-RADS 2: benign. Routine annual screening.

title: 유방 초음파
text: 결론: 우측 유방 2시 방향 1.1 cm 불규칙한 저에코 종괴. BI-RADS 카테고리 4B. 초음파 유도하 조직검사 권함.

title: Chest radiograph PA/lateral
text: IMPRESSION: Right lower lobe consolidation consistent with pneumonia. Recommend follow-up chest radiograph in 6-8 weeks after treatment to document resolution.
rationale: Follow-up CXR after pneumonia in a former smoker.

title: CT abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 1.6 cm indeterminate hypoenhancing lesion in hepatic segment 7, too small to characterize further on this single-phase study. Recommend contrast-enhanced liver MRI within 3 months.

title: Pelvic ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 3.0 cm simple-appearing left ovarian cyst in a premenopausal woman, O-RADS US 2. No follow-up imaging needed.
rationale: Simple cyst <5 cm premenopausal: no follow-up.

title: 간 초음파
text: 결론: 간 S6에 1.4 cm 크기의 경계가 불분명한 저에코 결절. 3개월 후 역동적 간 MRI 권함.

title: Liver ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Hepatic steatosis. 1.0 cm hemangioma in segment 6, typical appearance, stable since 2023. No follow-up needed.

title: Brain MRI
text: IMPRESSION: 9 mm enhancing extra-axial lesion along the left frontal convexity with dural tail, most consistent with a meningioma. No mass effect. Recommend follow-up MRI brain in 12 months.

title: Surgical pathology: breast core biopsy
text: DIAGNOSIS: Left breast, 10 o'clock, ultrasound-guided core biopsy: Invasive ductal carcinoma, Nottingham grade 2. ER positive, PR positive, HER2 equivocal (2+); FISH pending.

title: Surgical pathology: breast core biopsy
text: DIAGNOSIS: Right breast, core biopsy: Fibroadenoma. Negative for atypia and malignancy. Concordant with imaging.

title: Cervical biopsy
text: DIAGNOSIS: Cervix, 12 o'clock biopsy: High-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL; CIN 3). Negative for invasive carcinoma.

title: 위 내시경 조직검사
text: 진단: 위 전정부, 내시경 생검: 선암 (adenocarcinoma), 중등도 분화.

title: Gastric biopsy
text: DIAGNOSIS: Stomach, antrum, biopsy: Mild chronic inactive gastritis. Helicobacter pylori immunostain negative. No intestinal metaplasia, dysplasia or malignancy.
rationale: Mild chronic gastritis, no dysplasia: no obligation.

title: Breast core biopsy
text: DIAGNOSIS: Left breast, stereotactic core biopsy of calcifications: Atypical ductal hyperplasia. Recommend surgical excision.
rationale: ADH on core biopsy: surgical referral.
